verification_method: Independent direct OpenCascade intersections of delivered assembled-frame STEP geometry; supplied print-to-assembled matrices used separately for STL rendering.
limitations: Rigid geometry checks do not measure latch force, friction, print accuracy, bag seam bulk, fatigue or shipping performance. Source promises optional label inlay but exports only base and lid.

source_inspection.print_pose: STL exports already in submitted bed orientations, base upright and lid label-face-down
